content.short: Wafini is a Web 3.0 community-driven decentralized NFT Marketplace for Non-Fungible Tokens & NFT collectibles.
content.description:
Wafini is a Web 3.0 community driven decentralized NFT Marketplace for Non-Fungible Tokens & NFT collectibles where users will be able to mint, list, sell and swap their Non fungible tokens utilizing the Cardano Blockchain.

Wafini users will be able to unlock the full potential of our NFT marketplace as we will be the first NFT Marktplace on Cardano that will give reflections of trade commisions on the Marketplace, thereby giving further utility to the Genesis NFTs which will ensure the sustainability and longevity of the Wafini Marketplace.
